```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = TRUE,
	message = FALSE,

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
```

## 1. Data Importing and Cleaning Pipeline

```{r clean-data}
# Create cleaned output directory if missing
dir.create("../data/cleaned", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# 1. Clean Metadata Table
meta_raw <- read_csv("data/raw/Meta Data FINAL v2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

meta_clean <- meta_raw %>%
  rename_with(str_trim) %>%
  rename(
    sample_id = `Sample ID`,
    treatment = `Treatment Group`,
    sex = SEX,
    genotype = `geno-type`,
    batch = `Run Batch`,
    tissue = `Tissue type`,
    time_point = `Time Point`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = str_trim(sample_id),
    treatment = str_to_title(str_trim(treatment)),
    sex = case_when(
      str_trim(sex) %in% c("F", "female") ~ "F",
      str_trim(sex) == "M" ~ "M",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    genotype = str_to_upper(str_trim(genotype)),
    batch = case_when(
      str_trim(batch) %in% c("B2", "Batch2") ~ "B2",
      TRUE ~ str_trim(batch)
    ),
    tissue = str_to_title(str_trim(tissue)),
    time_point = case_when(
      str_trim(time_point) %in% c("T24", "24h") ~ "T24",
      TRUE ~ str_trim(time_point)
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# 2. Clean Measurements Part 1
m1_raw <- read_csv("data/raw/measurements_part ONE_old.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

m1_clean <- m1_raw %>%
  rename_with(str_trim) %>%
  rename(
    sample_id = sample,
    gene_a = `Gene A`,
    gene_b = `gene-b`,
    gene_c = GeneC,
    qc_note = Comments
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = str_to_upper(str_trim(sample_id)),
    gene_a = as.numeric(gene_a),
    gene_b = ifelse(gene_b == "n.d.", NA, gene_b),
    gene_b = as.numeric(gene_b),
    gene_c = str_replace(gene_c, ",", "."),
    gene_c = as.numeric(gene_c),
    source_file = "part1"
  )

# 3. Clean Measurements Part 2
m2_raw <- read_csv("data/raw/Results_2_NEW (use this).csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

m2_clean <- m2_raw %>%
  rename_with(str_trim) %>%
  rename(
    sample_id = SampleName,
    gene_a = gene_a,
    gene_b = `Gene B`,
    gene_c = `GENE C`,
    qc_note = `operator note`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = str_to_upper(str_replace_all(str_trim(sample_id), "-", "")),
    gene_a = ifelse(str_detect(gene_a, "approx"), str_extract(gene_a, "^[0-9.]+"), gene_a),
    gene_a = as.numeric(gene_a),
    gene_b = ifelse(gene_b == "missing", NA, gene_b),
    gene_b = as.numeric(gene_b),
    gene_c = as.numeric(gene_c),
    source_file = "part2"
  )

# Combine measurements
measurements_combined <- bind_rows(m1_clean, m2_clean)

# Save cleaned CSV files
write_csv(meta_clean, "../data/cleaned/metadata_clean.csv")
write_csv(measurements_combined, "../data/cleaned/measurements_combined_clean.csv")
```

## 2. Sample Overlap Analysis

```{r overlap-summary}
all_samples <- sort(unique(c(meta_clean$sample_id, measurements_combined$sample_id)))

overlap_table <- tibble(sample_id = all_samples) %>%
  mutate(
    in_meta = sample_id %in% meta_clean$sample_id,
    in_part1 = sample_id %in% m1_clean$sample_id,
    in_part2 = sample_id %in% m2_clean$sample_id,
    category = case_when(
      in_meta & in_part1 & in_part2 ~ "Metadata + Part1 + Part2",
      in_meta & in_part1 & !in_part2 ~ "Metadata + Part1 only",
      in_meta & !in_part1 & in_part2 ~ "Metadata + Part2 only",
      !in_meta & in_part1 & !in_part2 ~ "Part1 only (Missing Metadata)",
      !in_meta & !in_part1 & in_part2 ~ "Part2 only (Missing Metadata)",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

kable(overlap_table, caption = "Systematic Sample Overlap Audit")
```

## 3. Visualizing Gene Expression

```{r plot-expression, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
merged_data <- measurements_combined %>%
  left_join(meta_clean, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(genotype), !is.na(treatment))

ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = genotype, y = gene_a, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Gene A Expression by Genotype and Treatment",
    subtitle = "Cleaned dataset",
    x = "Genotype",
    y = "Gene A Expression",
    fill = "Treatment"
  )
```
